text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of a designated on-street accessible loading zone on the east side of Ellington Drive, between Lawrence Avenue East and Guild Hall Drive. The accessible loading zone will operate from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. The establishment of this accessible loading zone (ALZ) will provide unimpeded curbside access for the Wheel-Trans users in the subject area.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to be in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Ellington Drive, between a point 112 metres south of Guild Hall Drive and a point 13.5 metres further south.
